display.purpose: Hero statement only, paired with annotation strips and full-bleed hairlines.

body.purpose: Hero supporting copy and long-form reading, capped at the 768px medium breakpoint.

label.purpose: System annotations above and below hero blocks at low opacity.

motion.name: hero-reveal
motion.purpose: Headline and body slide up from 100% on first paint.

motion.name: body-reveal-delay
motion.purpose: Delays the supporting paragraph behind the headline.

motion.name: chip-spring

motion.name: theme-reveal

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact azure action with a color-only hover and a one-pixel pressed shift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 18.8px); background: var(--primary, oklch(0.6723 0.1606 244.9955)); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font-family: var(--font-sans, Outfit, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.625; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.6723 0.1606 244.9955)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.354)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.354)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 18.8px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #111); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, #eee); color: var(--foreground, #111); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.354)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.354)) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Navigation Shell
components.description: Fixed floating pill with avatar left and theme toggle plus text links right.
components.html: ProjectsBlogComponents
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: center; width: 100%; } .ds-nav-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 93%; max-width: 1152px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background, #fff) 50%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-nav-avatar { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Outfit, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; color: var(--foreground, #111); } .ds-nav-links a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 18.8px); background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-toggle:hover { background: var(--muted, #eee); }

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular portrait with a one-pixel hairline edge.
components.css: .ds-avatar { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd); overflow: hidden; } .ds-avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact field with a tonal fill and ring-based focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.9809 0.0025 228.7836)); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 18.8px); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.9809 0.0025 228.7836)) 20%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #111); font-family: var(--font-sans, Outfit, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #777); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.354)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6818 0.1584 243.354)) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Annotation Label
components.description: Low-opacity monospace strip that names the utilities applied to the hero.
components.css: .ds-annotation { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.25em; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.625rem; line-height: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, #111) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Hatched Rail
components.description: The fixed edge pattern that frames the content column like a canvas.
components.html: Content sits inside the rails.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 120px; background: var(--background, #fff); } .ds-stage-rail { flex: 0 0 32px; background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #ddd) 50%, transparent); border-left: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd); border-right: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(315deg, var(--border, #ddd) 0, var(--border, #ddd) 1px, transparent 0, transparent 50%); background-size: 10px 10px; } .ds-stage-copy { flex: 1; margin: 0; padding: 16px; color: var(--foreground, #111); font-family: var(--font-sans, Outfit, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
The interface behaves like a live design surface that can be inspected while it is being read. Full-bleed hairlines separate the hero beats, hatched rails frame the content column, and small monospace annotations name the exact typographic utilities applied to each line. The effect is technical without becoming a terminal: the annotation layer is quiet, low-contrast, and always secondary to the work.

The mood is precise and technical. Surfaces are flat, corners are generously rounded, and controls are compact, quiet instruments rather than loud calls to action. Outfit carries the reading voice; IBM Plex Mono appears only where the system is talking about itself. Light and dark themes are treated as absolute ends of the same system, with paper white and true black as anchors rather than soft off-whites or charcoals.

This world must never be mistaken for a generic SaaS gradient landing page. There are no purple-blue hero gradients, floating glass orbs, or stacked marketing cards. Structure is communicated with one-pixel lines, tonal fills, and full-bleed rules. The portrait, the work, and the annotation system carry the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Annotated hero: mono class labels sit directly above and below the headline.
Full-bleed hairlines and hatched edge rails define the column.
Flat by default: no drop shadows anywhere in the system.
One azure accent used sparingly against pure paper or true black.
Large, soft radii on compact controls; thin borders everywhere else.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Azure occupies less than a tenth of any viewport. It appears on the hero name and the rotating chip; spreading it to section backgrounds, borders, or decorative gradients breaks the system.

rules.name: The Absolute Ends Rule
rules.body: The neutral ends are pure white in light mode and pure black in dark mode. Depth and softness come from tinted foregrounds and hairlines, never from a beige or charcoal page background.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Monospace labels describe the system and never carry primary content. They stay at 10–12px, in lowercase, and at 20–25% foreground opacity.

rules.name: The Four-Step Display Rule
rules.body: The hero headline steps through 1.5rem, 3rem, 3.75rem, and 6rem at its responsive breakpoints. Do not introduce intermediate display sizes; the jump is part of the voice.

rules.name: The Rail Rule
rules.body: Content never touches the viewport edge on desktop. The hatched rails own the outer 2rem, and no card or image may overlap them.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structural separators escape the column to 200vw. Use the established pseudo-element technique rather than border-top on the content wrapper.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separation, use a hairline, a tonal fill, or blur. Never add a drop shadow, glow, or floating glass card.

rules.name: The One Radius Family Rule
rules.body: All corners derive from the single 1.3rem base. Do not mix sharp-cornered cards with pill controls in the same cluster.

dos: Do keep azure below roughly 10% of any viewport and reserve it for identity and current-focus moments.
Do use full-bleed hairlines and the hatched rails to create structure instead of cards or shadows.
Do render system annotations in IBM Plex Mono at 10–12px with 20–25% foreground opacity.
Do move the display headline through exactly 1.5rem, 3rem, 3.75rem, and 6rem at the existing breakpoints.
Do pair large radii (16.8–24.8px) with one-pixel borders on compact controls.
Do keep hero reveals at 0.4s ease-in-out and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows, or floating glass cards; the system is flat.
Don't introduce gradient heroes, purple-blue SaaS palettes, or decorative orb imagery.
Don't use azure as a section background, border color, or multi-stop gradient.
Don't set body copy wider than the 768px medium breakpoint.
Don't use the reserved Georgia serif for UI or body copy; it is currently dormant.
Don't use monospace for paragraphs or primary reading content.
